title: IGP Groundwater Study — Reproducibility Bundle (v5.1)
description:
Complete Python analysis pipeline for the manuscript 'Long-term groundwater depletion across the Upper Indo-Gangetic Plain: GRACE/GRACE-FO observations 2002-2023, depth-stratified well-network analysis, and Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification', submitted to Water Resources Research.

The bundle reproduces the headline results of the manuscript from raw NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO mascon data, GLDAS-2.1 Noah land-surface model output, MODIS MOD16A2GF evapotranspiration, CHIRPS v3.0 rainfall, and the Central Ground Water Board of India well network: a -34.86 mm/yr groundwater storage trend (Theil-Sen 95% CI: +/-1.03 mm/yr), within-JPL/GLDAS structural uncertainty of +/-0.32 mm/yr from a 2000-iteration Monte Carlo over five error sources, combined quadrature uncertainty of +/-1.08 mm/yr, cumulative loss of approximately 413 km^3 over 22 years, and a primary change-point in August 2015 robust across three GWS variants.

The bundle is scripts-only: raw input data is not redistributed because each underlying dataset has its own license and acquisition pathway. The README documents how to obtain each input.

Eighteen Python scripts: seven upstream pipeline scripts (numbered 01-07) that read raw data and produce intermediate CSVs; eight analysis scripts (R1-R4, R6-R9; there is no R5) that produce the manuscript tables and intermediate figures; and one figure-generator script (F) that produces the 12 manuscript figures. Vectorised SSA decomposition, gap-filling via iterative SSA at L=60, Theil-Sen rank-based regression, Pettitt and Buishand and ruptures change-point detection, and full Monte Carlo trend uncertainty propagation.
notes: The DOI of the corresponding manuscript will be added as a related identifier (relation: 'isSupplementTo') after acceptance at Water Resources Research.
